entities.summary: Sendai Daikannon , officially known as the Sendai Tendou Byakue Daikannon (仙台天道白衣大観音), is a large statue located in Sendai, Japan. It portrays a woman, the bodhisattva Byakue Kannon  holding the cintamani gem  in her hand.
